Decision reference missing: Parallel lane execution with deterministic merge ordering independent of wall-clock completion timing to maximize throughput while preserving reproducibility.

Decision reference missing: Dedicated Integration sub-flow (C18→C19→C20→C21) as a first-class workflow stage with its own validation, review, and repair cycle to catch cross-lane regressions and merge conflicts.
Decision reference missing: Namespaced workspace partitions (C22) isolating per-lane canonical/non-canonical content with a shared integration partition, unified under workspace_index.json.

Decision reference missing: Medium HITL strictness: automated lane-level validation with HITL triggers concentrated at integration conflicts exceeding deterministic thresholds, security critical findings, secrets detection, and ChangeRequest approvals.

Decision reference missing: Two-tier acceptance: lane-scoped gates must pass before fan-in; integrated state must pass full system-level validators, integration review, and judge assessment before freeze.
Decision reference missing: Sandboxed tooling with deny-by-default network, repo-write only via patch_apply, and per-stage tool permission matrix enforced by C11.
Decision reference missing: Deterministic smallest-passing-repair selection (fewest ops → fewest bytes → first-generated) applied at both lane and integration repair stages.
Decision reference missing: Stage handoff artifacts emitted at every checkpoint boundary (lane transitions, integration transitions, judge, freeze) for cold-start resumability.
